[FACT] User is interested in meal prep.

[PREFERENCE] User enjoys quinoa and roasted vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested protein sources that pair well with quinoa and roasted vegetables:  
1. Grilled Chicken  
2. Pan-Seared Salmon  
3. Lentil or Mushroom Bolognese

9. Edamame  
10. Tempeh  
[PREFERENCE] User has had grilled chicken and turkey breast before.  
[PREFERENCE] User has never tried lentil or mushroom bolognese.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided a simple recipe for Lentil Bolognese:  
- Ingredients: 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 1 can crushed tomatoes, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, pepper, red wine (optional).  
- Instructions: Sauté aromatics, add mushrooms, lentils, spices, tomatoes, and wine, simmer for 20-25 minutes.  
[PREFERENCE] User requested suggestions for sides or add-ins to go with lentil bolognese and quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested sides and add-ins:  
- Roasted Vegetables: broccoli, Brussels sprouts, sweet potato wedges, carrots, asparagus.  
- Sautéed Greens: spinach, kale, collard greens.  
- Crunchy Add-ins: toasted pumpkin seeds, fresh herbs, crushed red pepper flakes, sliced nuts.  
- Cheesy Delights: shaved Parmesan, crumbled feta, grated mozzarella.  
- Other Options: sliced bell peppers, chopped fresh herbs, artichoke hearts, sliced avocado.  
[FACT] User is thinking of adding roasted sweet potatoes to their meal prep this week.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested seasoning options for roasted sweet potatoes:  
1. Classic Herbs: olive oil, salt, pepper, chopped fresh rosemary.  
2. Spicy Kick: olive oil, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika.  
3. Mediterranean Style: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, dried oregano.  
4. Sweet and Smoky: olive oil, brown sugar, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper.  
5. Indian-Inspired: olive oil, garam masala, cumin, coriander.  
6. Lemon Rosemary: olive oil, lemon zest, minced garlic, chopped rosemary.  
7. Simple Salt and Pepper.  
[PREFERENCE] User chose to go with the Classic Herbs option for seasoning their roasted sweet potatoes.
